guard: a spawn may be granted the event plane of the agent it is creating and no other, over both ACL fields, and the wildcard form is deliberately left to ordinary ACL authority
why: An event channel carries a session's tool inputs and outputs verbatim. On a static mesh there is
no ledger, so a caller-supplied allowSubscribe/allowPublish is attenuated by nothing at all: a
caller that may spawn may otherwise mint its child a read on any subject it names, including
The three mutations are chosen so that no two of them redden the same cell. E1 removes the rule
entirely. E2 leaves the rule but narrows its INPUT to one of the two ACL fields, which is the
shape a refactor produces and which E1 cannot distinguish. E3 goes the other way and makes the
rule catch more than it claims to, which is the only way to show the stated-limit cell is an
SPECIFIER BOUNDARY. The suite imports the manager by relative source path (../src/manager.js), so
the mutated file is the file that runs and there is no build in the command. Its package-name
imports are core's eventChannel/eventChannelPrincipal/isEventChannel, which the cells compare the
manager AGAINST; no mutation below replaces them, so a kill cannot come from moving both sides.

mutations.name: E1 the rule finds nothing foreign, ever
mutations.expectRed: a spawn asking for ANOTHER agent's event channel to READ is refused
mutations.cell: a spawn asking for ANOTHER agent's event channel to READ is refused
mutations.note: The rule deleted at its predicate rather than at its call site, so the surrounding throw and its message survive and cannot pass the cell by themselves.

mutations.name: E2 the rule reads the read-set only, and forgets the post-set
mutations.expectRed: a spawn asking to POST to another agent's event channel is refused too
mutations.cell: a spawn asking to POST to another agent's event channel is refused too
mutations.note: The half-fence. It reads as the obvious one, because read amplification is the risk people name first, and it leaves a caller able to mint publish rights onto another agent's plane, which is forgery rather than eavesdropping. E1 cannot tell this mutant from a healthy tree.

mutations.name: E3 the rule catches the wildcard form too, which it does not claim to
mutations.expectRed: a WILDCARD event pattern is NOT refused by this rule
mutations.cell: a WILDCARD event pattern is NOT refused by this rule
mutations.note: The limit asserted from the other side. Without this, the cell recording the gap would be satisfied by any tree, including one that had quietly closed it, and the comment describing the limit would be a sentence nobody tests.
